org: African American Arts Institute, Indiana University Bloomington
deadline_text: Camp is June 13 to 18, 2027 on the IU Bloomington campus. The page has an Apply now link but does not state an application deadline.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply now link on the camp page (an online form). Students are selected.
name: Camp S.O.U.L. (Students Obtaining Unique musical Levels)
what_you_do: Six days on the IU campus to study Black American music, from gospel and blues to jazz and hip-hop. You learn from pros and IU teachers. You also learn how to get ready for college.
who_can_apply: Gifted high school students, such as singers, players and spoken word artists. Students are picked. Age and grade limits are not listed.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the program page
notes: Contact campsoul@iu.edu or the director, Ignoisco Miles. His email is imiles@iu.edu and his phone is 812-855-0816. Ask about cost and how to audition before you apply.
